mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as financing costs compress for corporate investment.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger immediate equity selling due to reduced consumer spending confidence, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production and housing starts indicate a broad-based economic contraction in manufacturing and construction sectors, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings expectations deteriorate.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when both INDPRO and HOUST decline from prior 2-month levels.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 260), a federal funds rate increase above 0.5% signals aggressive monetary tightening that raises equity discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 260 and FEDFUNDS > 0.5.

mechanism_narrative: Non-farm payrolls exceeding 140 million indicate robust labor market conditions that support sustained consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS > 140 million.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts falling below 1600 thousand units signals weakening residential demand that precedes broader consumer spending slowdowns, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 1600.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in retail sales and housing starts indicate collapsing consumer demand across multiple sectors, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as earnings revisions accelerate downward.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when both RSAFS and HOUST decline from prior 2-month levels.

mechanism_narrative: In manufacturing slowdown regimes (INDPRO < 105), a rising unemployment rate above 6.0% signals deepening economic contraction that triggers risk-off sentiment, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO < 105 and UNRATE > 6.0.
